indicator_name: National Fund receipts: excess profit tax, year-to-date, monthly
description: Налог на сверхприбыль (поступления в Национальный фонд), нарастающим итогом с начала года, помесячно
methodology: Million KZT (source: thousand KZT), National Fund of the Republic of Kazakhstan, excess profit tax (oil sector), YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative (January to the month dated): the report 'as of 1 <month>' is dated the month before, 'as of 1 January' is December. From every Minfin 'Statement of receipts and application of the National Fund' in the listing (106 of 106 parsed; the approved annual reports for 2018 and 2024 stand in for the missing reports as of 1 January 2019 and 2025; the latest posting wins, 1 revised point(s) across the series). Every report passes seven taxes = direct taxes on the oil sector. History: 132 months 2007-2017 from KGD's «Динамика поступлений налогов и платежей в Национальный фонд» (data/reference/nf_receipts_kgd_history.csv; no 2005-2006 workbook that passes its own identity). KGD equals Minfin in all 7 shared Decembers; within the year 62 of 79 shared months are equal, the rest differ by payment timing (largest 0.9 bn KZT). Months no report covers are missing, not interpolated.
